supplements.title: Dendrobine inhibits the growth and invasion of human breast cancer cells by regulating the NF-κB signaling pathway via the SLC6A9 target.
supplements.summary: Dendrobine, a natural compound, stops breast cancer cell growth and spread by blocking the SLC6A9 protein and NF-κB signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Shaping Human Health and Nutrition Through Innovations in Spatial Metabolism.
supplements.summary: Spatial imaging technology reveals how diet reshapes tissue metabolism in cancer, liver disease, and brain health at high resolution.

supplements.title: In Vitro and In Vivo Study of Green-Synthesized Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles as a Novel Anticoccidial Agent.
supplements.summary: Green-synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles show promise as a new treatment for coccidiosis parasites in animals.

supplements.title: Can non-pharmacological strategies in cancer patients support perceived appetite? A scoping review.
supplements.summary: Non-pharmacological strategies like exercise and counseling may help improve appetite in cancer patients without medication.

supplements.title: From tumor reduction to behavioral improvement and cytokine balance: Therapeutic role of petroleum ether extract of Teucrium polium in a rat model of C6-induced glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Teucrium polium extract reduced glioblastoma tumors and improved anxiety and motor function in rats, suggesting potential as a complementary brain cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Ketogenic Diet Prevents Obesity-Associated Pancreatic Cancer Independent of Weight Loss and Induces Pancreatic Metabolic Reprogramming.
supplements.summary: Ketogenic diet delays pancreatic cancer progression in obese mice through metabolic changes, independent of weight loss.

supplements.title: Type 2 diabetes remission in gynaecologic oncology patients completing an acute preoperative weight loss protocol: a case series.
supplements.summary: Gynaecologic cancer patients with obesity who lost weight before surgery experienced remission or improvement in their type 2 diabetes.

supplements.title: Integrative bioinformatics and experimental validation reveal quercetin as a potential multi-target therapeutic agent in hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Quercetin, a natural compound, reduces liver cancer cell growth by targeting five key genes involved in tumor development.

supplements.title: ROS-mediated apoptosis in colon cancer cells induced by sulfated polysaccharides from Gracilaria corticata.
supplements.summary: Sulfated polysaccharides from red algae trigger colon cancer cell death through oxidative stress mechanisms.

supplements.title: In-silico prediction of multi‑target mechanisms of Pinellia ternata phytochemicals in lung cancer: Evidence from a graph‑attention‑guided virtual screening and multi‑scale simulations.
supplements.summary: Computational analysis identifies baicalein from Pinellia ternata as a promising multi-target compound against lung cancer by targeting key proteins like PTK2 and KDR.

supplements.title: Phytosomes against melanoma: disrupting molecular pathways with targeted phytochemical delivery.
supplements.summary: Phytosomes—nanoparticles delivering plant compounds—overcome poor absorption to effectively target melanoma through multiple cancer pathways.

supplements.title: Exploring the anticancer potential of Streptomyces sp. M4 extract: effects on apoptosis in gastric cancer ags cells.
supplements.summary: Streptomyces sp. M4 extract kills gastric cancer cells by triggering apoptosis through the extrinsic death pathway.

supplements.title: Platycodin D Overcomes Cisplatin Resistance in Gastric Cancer by Inducing Ferroptosis through TLK1-Dependent UHRF2/DNMT3A/ALOX15 Pathway.
supplements.summary: Platycodin D helps overcome cisplatin resistance in gastric cancer by triggering a specific cell death pathway.

supplements.title: Molecular mechanism of aloe emodin in combating nasopharyngeal carcinoma revealed through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vitro experiments.
supplements.summary: Aloe emodin inhibits nasopharyngeal cancer by blocking the EGFR/SRC/STAT3 signaling pathway and reducing tumor-promoting protein expression.

supplements.title: (Poly)phenol profiles of plant-based diets assessed through dietary intake and urinary biomarkers.
supplements.summary: Plant-based diets contain significantly higher levels of protective plant compounds called polyphenols compared to omnivorous diets.

off_label.title: Dyslipidaemias in cancer patients.
off_label.summary: Cancer survivors face high heart disease risk from both cancer treatments and high cholesterol, requiring personalized monitoring and cholesterol-lowering therapy strategies.

off_label.title: Type 2 diabetes and gynecologic cancers: Immunometabolic convergence and translational implications.
off_label.summary: Type 2 diabetes worsens outcomes in gynecologic cancers, particularly endometrial and cervical cancer, through shared metabolic pathways that metformin may help address.

off_label.title: ETS1 Orchestrates a Hybrid EMT Program Driving Metastasis and Immune Evasion.
off_label.summary: ETS1 protein drives metastasis and immune evasion in squamous cell carcinoma, and HSP90 inhibitors may block this process.

off_label.title: Imatinib-Induced Hemorrhage in the Corpus Luteum Is Attenuated in Pseudopregnant and Hypophysectomized Rats.
off_label.summary: Imatinib causes ovarian bleeding in normal rats but not when estrous cycles are halted, suggesting ovulation suppression may prevent this side effect.

off_label.title: FGFR1 but not S6K1/2 drives intrinsic BRAF inhibitor resistance in melanoma.
off_label.summary: FGFR1, not S6K1/2 signaling, drives melanoma's resistance to BRAF inhibitors, suggesting FGFR inhibitors may overcome this resistance.

off_label.title: A phenothiazine analog, PTF, suppresses breast cancer growth by inhibiting YAP signaling.
off_label.summary: PTF, a modified phenothiazine compound, effectively kills breast cancer cells by blocking YAP signaling and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with cancer are associated with reduced all-cause mortality and hospitalization.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonist drugs reduce death and hospital stays in cancer patients.

off_label.title: Equilibrium and non-equilibrium thermodynamics in drug repurposing: Machine learning-guided discovery of high-affinity WEE1 kinase inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Machine learning identified existing drugs like acarbose that effectively inhibit WEE1 kinase, a cancer cell cycle target, through computational screening.

off_label.title: Changes in metabolic and pulmonary outcomes after discontinuation of glucagon-like-peptide-1 receptor agonist therapy in people with cystic fibrosis.
off_label.summary: Stopping GLP-1 drugs in cystic fibrosis patients reversed weight loss and worsened blood sugar control and lung function.

off_label.title: Canonical microRNA loss drives tumor development, implicating therapeutic efficacy of enoxacin in angiosarcoma.
off_label.summary: Loss of microRNA processing drives angiosarcoma development, and the antibiotic enoxacin restores tumor-suppressive miRNAs to slow cancer growth.

off_label.title: Novel statin derivatives as non-competitive inhibitors of human adenylate kinase 1: synthesis, enzyme inhibition, molecular docking, and biological studies.
off_label.summary: Novel statin-based compounds selectively inhibit adenylate kinase 1, showing promise as therapeutic agents with potential applications in cancer and other diseases.

off_label.title: Beyond malaria prevention: sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine treatment in pregnancy selectively remodels the maternal gut microbiome to increase gestational weight gain and improve birthweight
off_label.summary: Antimalarial drug sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine improves pregnancy outcomes by altering gut bacteria to increase maternal weight gain and birthweight.

off_label.title: Pre-treatment of cabozantinib prior to hypofractionated radiotherapy increases immunomodulatory effects and tumor size reduction in a 4T1 breast cancer murine model.
off_label.summary: Combining cabozantinib with radiotherapy reduces breast cancer tumors and boosts anti-tumor immune responses in mice.

off_label.title: Prenatal Diagnosis and Management of Kaposiform Hemangioendothelioma With Kasabach-Merritt Phenomenon: Imaging Features and First Experience With Maternal Sirolimus Therapy.
off_label.summary: Pregnant woman received a drug called sirolimus to treat a rare blood vessel tumor in the fetus, successfully managing a life-threatening bleeding complication.

off_label.title: Emerging concepts, hot topics, and open questions in today's pancreatic cancer research.
off_label.summary: Pancreatic cancer researchers identify emerging approaches—including microenvironment studies, immunotherapy, and microbiome research—to improve survival rates.

biomarkers.title: Developing a preliminarily validated competency-based integrative oncology training questionnaire.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created a questionnaire to measure whether healthcare trainees have essential skills for providing integrative cancer care.

biomarkers.title: Thyroid cancer-derived exosomal SPP1 promotes tumor progression by driving macrophage M2 polarization through the CD44/JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Thyroid cancer cells release particles containing SPP1 that reprogram immune cells to support tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: TGFA promotes the development of cervical cancer via interacting with DSG2.
biomarkers.summary: TGFA protein promotes cervical cancer growth by binding to DSG2 and activating a pathway that increases cell proliferation and spread.

biomarkers.title: Polyploid giant cancer cells: the hidden players in ovarian cancer progression and prognosis.
biomarkers.summary: Polyploid giant cancer cells in ovarian cancer generate aggressive, drug-resistant daughter cells, driving tumor relapse and therapy resistance.

biomarkers.title: Novel bispecific T-cell engagers overcoming acquired EGFR resistance.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created new T-cell engaging drugs that overcome EGFR resistance mutations in cancer, showing improved tumor-killing in tests.

biomarkers.title: Evolving Treatment Paradigms in Hormone Receptor-Positive, Human Epidermal Growth Factor 2-Negative Metastatic Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Hormone receptor-positive breast cancer treatment now emphasizes personalized approaches using targeted drugs and antibodies alongside hormone therapy, prioritizing patient quality of life.

biomarkers.title: Biomarkers for Diagnosis, Risk Stratification, and Immunotherapy of Pediatric Solid Tumors.
biomarkers.summary: Biomarkers help diagnose pediatric solid tumors and guide treatment selection, with emerging blood tests showing promise for predicting outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Dendrobine inhibits the growth and invasion of human breast cancer cells by regulating the NF-κB signaling pathway via the SLC6A9 target.
biomarkers.summary: Dendrobine, a natural compound, stops breast cancer cell growth and spread by blocking the SLC6A9 protein and NF-κB signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Pathologic and radiologic response to neoadjuvant therapy in advanced differentiated thyroid cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Neoadjuvant therapy can shrink advanced thyroid cancer before surgery, potentially reducing the extent of surgical removal needed.

biomarkers.title: The Greenland shark genome: Insights into lifespan extremes and population dynamics.
biomarkers.summary: Greenland shark genome reveals cancer resistance and enhanced DNA repair mechanisms associated with extreme longevity in this long-lived species.

biomarkers.title: Molecular insight into the interplay among heterogeneous plasmacytes and microenvironment cells and their clinical relevance in myeloma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a specific myeloma cell subtype with high proliferation and developed a prognostic score to better predict multiple myeloma outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Performance of the permutation test approach with base calling errors for detecting changes in variant allele frequencies in ctDNA for a single patient.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a permutation test to reliably detect changes in circulating tumor DNA levels over time, accounting for sequencing errors.

biomarkers.title: When Infection Masquerades as Metastasis: Tuberculous Spondylodiscitis with Fibrous Dysplasia and Capillary Hemangioma in a Patient with Newly Diagnosed Hepatic Mass.
biomarkers.summary: Spinal tuberculosis can mimic cancer metastasis, especially when benign vertebral lesions and liver abnormalities coexist, requiring biopsy confirmation.

biomarkers.title: Tissue-specific factors that govern the sialoglycan-Siglec axis in cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer cells use sialylated molecules to suppress immune attacks through Siglec receptors, with patterns varying by tissue type and tumor composition.

biomarkers.title: Transcriptomic and functional analysis of fibroid extracellular vesicles.
biomarkers.summary: Fibroid-derived exosomes promote fibroid growth by reprogramming normal uterine cells toward a fibroid-like state with increased proliferation and inflammation.

trials.title: Mind-Body Therapies for Depression and Anxiety Symptoms in People with Cancer: A Systematic Review with Network Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: Mind-body therapies effectively reduce depression and anxiety symptoms in cancer patients, with yoga and meditation showing the most promise.

trials.title: [What do we know about compassion focused therapy for anxiety and depressive symptoms: A scoping review].
trials.summary: Compassion-focused therapy helps reduce anxiety and depression by building self-compassion, particularly for patients with shame and self-criticism.

trials.title: Effects of traditional Chinese exercises for upper-limb dysfunction following breast cancer surgery: protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Researchers will analyze whether traditional Chinese exercises improve arm function and quality of life after breast cancer surgery.

trials.title: Developing a preliminarily validated competency-based integrative oncology training questionnaire.
trials.summary: Researchers created a questionnaire to measure whether healthcare trainees have essential skills for providing integrative cancer care.

trials.title: Novel bispecific T-cell engagers overcoming acquired EGFR resistance.
trials.summary: Researchers created new T-cell engaging drugs that overcome EGFR resistance mutations in cancer, showing improved tumor-killing in tests.

trials.title: Evolving Treatment Paradigms in Hormone Receptor-Positive, Human Epidermal Growth Factor 2-Negative Metastatic Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Hormone receptor-positive breast cancer treatment now emphasizes personalized approaches using targeted drugs and antibodies alongside hormone therapy, prioritizing patient quality of life.

trials.title: Biomarkers for Diagnosis, Risk Stratification, and Immunotherapy of Pediatric Solid Tumors.
trials.summary: Biomarkers help diagnose pediatric solid tumors and guide treatment selection, with emerging blood tests showing promise for predicting outcomes.

trials.title: Pathologic and radiologic response to neoadjuvant therapy in advanced differentiated thyroid cancer.
trials.summary: Neoadjuvant therapy can shrink advanced thyroid cancer before surgery, potentially reducing the extent of surgical removal needed.

trials.title: Molecular insight into the interplay among heterogeneous plasmacytes and microenvironment cells and their clinical relevance in myeloma.
trials.summary: Researchers identified a specific myeloma cell subtype with high proliferation and developed a prognostic score to better predict multiple myeloma outcomes.

trials.title: Synergizing immunity: lipid nanoparticle-mediated mRNA and gene delivery as a next-gen paradigm in cancer immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Lipid nanoparticles effectively deliver mRNA-based treatments that boost the immune system's ability to fight cancer.

trials.title: CLL1 polymeric nanoparticles loaded with PI3K/BRD4 dual inhibitor MDP5 and azacitidine as a novel treatment for TP53 mutated acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Novel nanoparticles targeting CLL1 deliver dual drugs to effectively treat TP53-mutated acute myeloid leukemia while sparing healthy blood cells.

trials.title: Tissue-Free Circulating Tumor DNA Assay and Patient Outcome in a Phase III Trial of FOLFOX-Based Adjuvant Chemotherapy (Alliance N0147).
trials.summary: A blood test detecting cancer DNA after surgery predicts which colon cancer patients will relapse and may guide future treatment decisions.

trials.title: Cancer-associated fibroblast-derived protein S100-A11 influences the response to anti-HER2 therapies in HER2-positive breast cancer.
trials.summary: A protein called S100-A11, released by fibroblasts in HER2-positive breast cancer, reduces treatment effectiveness by activating a STAT3 signaling pathway.

trials.title: Prostate cancer screening: Decision-making when MRI results are inconclusive for cancer (PI-RADS 3).
trials.summary: Researchers recommend against biopsies for inconclusive prostate MRI results when patients would choose monitoring anyway, due to low cancer death risk.

trials.title: Interplay between viral oncolysis and host immunity in Newcastle disease virus-based cancer therapy.
trials.summary: Newcastle disease virus selectively kills cancer cells and activates immune responses, offering promise as a cancer therapy when genetically engineered.
